urdu: مارچ 2020 کے مطابق، 7.8 ارب افراد کی کتنی سرگرمیاں عالمی معیشت کے تخمینے میں شامل ہیں؟
english: As of March 2020, how many of the activities of 7.8 billion people are included in the global economic estimates?
roman_1: March 2020 ke mutabiq, 7.8 arab afraad ki kitni sar-garmiyan global maeeshat ke takhminay mein shamil hain?
roman_2: March 2020 kay mutabiq, 7.8 arab logon ki kitni sar-garmiyan aalami maeeshat ke takhmeene mein shamil hain?
roman_3: March 2020 ke mutabiq, 7.8 arab afraad ki kitni ser-garmiyan aaalmi maeeshat ke andazay mein shamil hain?
